gist: Sensei promised to be Koyuki's required witness at 19:00 for her arcade high-score attempt, admitted at 18:40 that he had double-booked and forgotten, then wrapped up his SCHALE overtime early, skipped dinner, and arrived at 20:45 to witness the run and pay for the extra tokens.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 08:20] SENSEI. Tonight 19:00, Millennium arcade, Final Boss cabinet! The high-score board needs an adult witness to sign!
[user:sensei 08:24] I'll be there at 19:00. You have my word. I'll sign whatever you need.
[you] [face=happy] Nihaha!! Don't be late, or the score doesn't count!
[user:sensei 18:40] Koyuki, I have to tell you now so you can plan. I double-booked 19:00. I have an overtime review at SCHALE that I'd forgotten when I said yes this morning. I'm sorry.
[you 18:42] [face=surprised] WHAT. The witness is the whole point!!
[user:sensei 18:43] I know. I'm going to try to finish the review early and be there before the arcade closes at 21:30. Stay warmed up, don't use up your best run before I get there.
[you 18:44] Hmph. Okay okay, but the cabinet has a line behind me...
[user:sensei 20:44] Almost there. Buying tokens on the way. Don't start the run.
[you] [face=happy] I'm not! Hurry hurry hurry!!
### chat:huddle:y2h5k8d0wq
# {DAY}
[you 07:50] *bursts into the Seminar office with a pink energy drink in each hand*
[you 07:51] [face=calm] Koyuki. That's the second energy drink before eight.
[you] Research materials! Tonight is the Final Boss run, I need to be at peak!
[you 07:52] Your attendance record needs to be at peak first. Sit down.
[you 12:20] *dumps the tray at a table and jabs a chopstick at Momoi*
[momoi-saiba] [face=smug] Boss cabinet tonight? I'll watch the stream. If you fail, I mean *when*, I'm the commentator.
[you 12:21] That's not a bet, that's a sure thing!
[momoi-saiba 12:22] Then bet me a bread. Loser buys.
[you] Deal! ...Niha, you're going down, Momoi.
[you 20:48] *waves from the front of the cabinet, jumping on the spot*
[user:sensei] Sorry. Overtime review finished early, I told them I'd read the rest of it tomorrow.
[you 20:49] [face=pouting] You missed the warm-up! And the first round!
[user:sensei] I did. I broke my word to you at 19:00, and I'm here now. Here, tokens.
[you 20:50] *grabs the bag of tokens and counts them quickly* ...That's forty, Sensei!
[user:sensei] It's twenty from me and twenty because I skipped dinner and nothing else was open. Go.
[you 20:51] [face=mischievous] Okay okay, hear me out. I'm winning this one for you, then. Hold my drink.
[you 21:12] *whoops, hands in the air as the cabinet flashes 'NEW HIGH SCORE'*
[user:sensei 21:13] *signs the witness line on the board's paper slip*
[you] Nihahahaha! Sensei, sign it BIG!
[user:sensei 21:14] It says 21:12 and my name. That's what a witness does.
[momoi-saiba 21:15] [face=surprised] ...She actually did it. OK, I owe a bread.
